checklist.done: the population is extracted and reconciled to the corporate calendar with no unresolved discrepancy.

checklist.step: Draw the risk-based sample
actions: Take 100% of annual meeting notices and any notice type with a prior-year finding.
Take a seeded random sample of 20 additional notices spread across remaining notice types and lines of business.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: the sample is drawn in AuditBoard, covering all high-risk notices plus a reproducible random draw.

checklist.step: Test content accuracy against the approved template
actions: For each sampled notice, pull the as-sent copy from the correspondence archive and the approved template version recorded in the notice inventory as current at the notice's generation date.
Compare content line-by-line, including the statutory citation footer and any variable data (dates, amounts).
Log any deviation as a content finding with severity based on whether the deviation affects a required statutory disclosure.
checklist.done: content is compared line-by-line for every sampled notice, with deviations logged and severity-rated.

checklist.step: Test timing accuracy against the statutory or by-law deadline
actions: For each sampled notice, recompute the required deadline from its triggering event date (e.g. 21 days before the meeting for the annual meeting notice).
Compare the recomputed deadline to the actual dispatch date recorded in the notice log.
Log any late dispatch as a timing finding with severity based on days late and recipient impact.
checklist.done: timing is independently recomputed and compared for every sampled notice, with late dispatch logged and severity-rated.

checklist.step: Verify delivery and recipient completeness
actions: For each sampled notice, confirm delivery confirmation exists for the full recipient list, not a partial batch.
Independently recompute the expected eligible-recipient count from the policy administration system as of the record date and compare to the dispatched count.
Log any recipient-completeness gap as a finding.
checklist.done: delivery and recipient completeness are verified for every sampled notice, with gaps logged as findings.

checklist.step: Trace prior-year findings to confirm remediation
actions: For every finding from the prior year's audit, pull the management action plan and confirm the recorded completion evidence.
Retest the specific control or process the finding addressed using a current-period example.
Close the finding only if the retest confirms the fix, otherwise log it as a repeat finding.
checklist.done: every prior-year finding is retested with a current-period example and closed or logged as a repeat finding.

checklist.step: Rate and document each finding
actions: For every content, timing or recipient-completeness finding, rate severity (high/medium/low) based on statutory impact and recipient count affected.
Document the finding with the specific notice(s), evidence and root cause in AuditBoard.
Route each finding to the accountable process owner (Policy Forms Specialist, Policy Administrator, Corporate Secretary, or IT) for a management response.
checklist.done: every finding is severity-rated, documented with evidence and root cause, and routed for a management response.

checklist.step: Obtain management action plans
actions: Collect a written action plan and target date from each process owner for their assigned findings.
Assess whether the target date allows remediation before the next occurrence of the affected notice's triggering event.
Escalate to the Chief Audit Executive any action plan that does not close before the next triggering event for a high-severity finding.
checklist.done: every finding carries a management action plan with a target date, escalated where a high-severity fix will not beat the next triggering event.

checklist.step: Draft the audit report
actions: Draft the report summarizing scope, sample, findings by severity, and management action plans.
State an overall opinion on notice content and timing compliance (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective).
Route the draft to the Chief Audit Executive for review.
checklist.done: a draft report with an overall opinion and management action plans is routed for Chief Audit Executive review.

checklist.step: Get Chief Audit Executive review and quality check
actions: Review the workpapers supporting each finding for sufficiency of evidence and correct severity rating.
Confirm the sample methodology and population reconciliation are documented and reproducible.
Approve the report for issuance or return with required workpaper corrections.
checklist.done: the report is approved for issuance with a documented quality check, or returned with corrections.

checklist.step: Issue the report and present to the Audit Committee
actions: Issue the final report to the process owners and Compliance leadership.
Present the report, including any high-severity finding, to the Audit Committee via the board portal at its next sitting.
Record the Committee's direction, including any requirement for interim status updates on open findings.
checklist.done: the report is issued and presented to the Audit Committee, with its direction recorded.

checklist.step: Retain the audit package
actions: Upload the audit plan, workpapers, sample evidence, findings and the issued report to the compliance evidence repository.
Apply the 7-year retention label from issuance.
Index the package by audit year and notice type.
checklist.done: the audit package is filed, retention-labelled and indexed by year and notice type.

checklist.step: Track open findings to closure
actions: Log every open finding and its target date in the regulatory filing/issue tracker for ongoing monitoring.
Follow up with process owners ahead of each target date for status.
Confirm closure evidence and get Chief Audit Executive sign-off before marking a finding closed.
checklist.done: open findings are tracked to a Chief Audit Executive-signed closure with confirmed evidence.

testing.step: Independently re-pull the notice population for the audited cycle
actions: Without referencing the original audit's extract, independently pull the notice log population for the same audit period from the policy administration system.
Compare the independently pulled count to the original audit's documented population count.
Log any discrepancy as a population-integrity exception.
testing.done: the population is independently re-pulled and reconciled to the original audit's documented count, or a discrepancy is logged.

testing.step: Reconcile the original sample to the selection methodology
actions: Using the recorded seed and population size in AuditBoard, reproduce the random sample selection.
Confirm the reproduced sample matches the original audit's tested sample exactly.
Confirm 100% coverage of the annual meeting notices and prior-year-finding notice types as documented.
testing.done: the sample is reproducible from the recorded seed and matches the original tested sample.

testing.step: Re-perform content testing on a sub-sample
actions: Select 8 notices from the original sample and independently compare the as-sent copy to the approved template version, without reading the original finding first.
Compare the independent conclusion to the original workpaper's conclusion for each.
Log any difference as a QA exception.
testing.done: content testing is independently re-performed on a sub-sample and compared to the original conclusions.

testing.step: Re-perform timing testing on a sub-sample
actions: For the same 8-notice sub-sample, independently recompute the statutory/by-law deadline from the triggering event date and compare to the recorded dispatch date.
Compare the independent timing conclusion to the original workpaper's conclusion.
Log any difference as a QA exception.
testing.done: timing testing is independently re-performed and compared to the original conclusions for the sub-sample.

testing.step: Verify finding severity ratings are supported and consistently applied
actions: Review every logged finding's evidence against the severity rating assigned.
Compare severity ratings across similar finding types (e.g. all late-annual-meeting-notice findings) for consistency.
Downgrade or upgrade any inconsistently rated finding and document the reason.
testing.done: severity ratings are independently checked for evidentiary support and consistency, with any correction documented.

testing.step: Verify prior-year finding closures were properly retested
actions: Pull every prior-year finding marked closed in the current audit and confirm a current-period retest example, not just a status update, supports the closure.
Reopen any finding closed without genuine retest evidence.
Document the basis for confirming or reopening each closure.
testing.done: prior-year closures are confirmed genuinely retested or reopened, with the basis documented.

testing.step: Confirm management action plans are tracked to target dates
actions: Pull the tracker record for every open finding from the current audit and confirm a target date and owner are recorded.
Confirm any high-severity finding's target date beats the next occurrence of the affected notice's triggering event.
Log any finding lacking a target date, owner, or adequate timeline as a QA exception.
testing.done: every open finding is confirmed tracked with an owner, target date and adequate timeline, or the gap is logged.

testing.step: Verify Audit Committee reporting occurred as required
actions: Confirm the audit report and any high-severity finding were actually presented to the Audit Committee, per the board portal minutes.
Confirm the Committee's recorded direction matches any interim status-update requirement.
Log any gap between required and actual Committee reporting.
testing.done: Audit Committee reporting is confirmed against board portal minutes, with any gap logged.

testing.step: Log every QA exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue for every exception found in steps 1 through 8, naming the specific finding or workpaper affected.
Assign a root cause (sample reproducibility gap, inconsistent severity rating, unretested closure) and an owner.
Set a remediation date and require it be addressed before the next annual audit plan is scoped.
testing.done: every QA exception has an issue, root cause, owner and a remediation date required before next cycle's planning.

testing.step: Conclude the QA review, sign and report
actions: Compute the QA exception rate against the 5% re-performance variance threshold.
Write the QA conclusion (audit reliable / reliable with exceptions / re-audit required) with evidence references.
Sign the QA workpaper as the independent reviewer, confirming no involvement in the original engagement.
Report the QA conclusion to the Audit Committee alongside the original audit report.
testing.done: a signed QA conclusion with exception rate is filed and reported to the Audit Committee alongside the original report.
